proposals.title: HUD density presets: Coached / Instruments / Clean
proposals.pitch: One key cycles all three optional panels: Coached (guide + advisor + intent), Instruments (intent and damage numbers only), Clean (CTB rail and party rows only), shown once on the first battle.
proposals.playerBenefit: A first-timer keeps the coaching; a returning player gets the painted game back instead of a wall of text.
proposals.cost: 1-2 days; the three booleans already exist in Settings.

proposals.title: Medals and a run scorecard on every clear
proposals.pitch: Grade each clear on turns, clear time, damage taken and objectives met, stamp Bronze/Silver/Gold/Pyrefly on the chapter card and print the one line that cost the top seal.
proposals.playerBenefit: Five one-shot fights become five things worth doing properly, and the objectives the game already writes finally mean something.
proposals.cost: 3-4 days; ChapterRecord already stores bestTimeMs, bestTurns, attempts, playTimeMs.
proposals.fidelityRisk: Low - thresholds must be set from real play so a faithful clear earns the top seal.

proposals.title: Accessibility pack: remapping, text scale, shape-coded statuses, flash safety, hold-to-confirm
proposals.pitch: A remap table over the existing abstract action set, a UI scale slider, a glyph beside every status and element chip, a flash cap on Overdrive and Mega Flare.
proposals.playerBenefit: The difference between 'most people can play this' and 'my friend can play this'; the scale slider also fixes sofa-distance legibility.
proposals.cost: 5-7 days; Input.ts already reduces everything to one abstract action set.

proposals.title: 'What is this?' cold open and a taught first chapter
proposals.pitch: A 20-second panel saying what the game is, which two games it recreates and how long it takes, then a guided Chapter 1.
proposals.playerBenefit: The link becomes sendable to someone who never played FFX.

proposals.title: Challenge ribbons: No Aeons, No Items, Solo, Low Level, Time Attack
proposals.pitch: Modifiers ticked on the prep CHAPTER tab before START BATTLE, shown on the clear seal and stacking into a difficulty multiplier.
proposals.playerBenefit: The cheapest way to make someone replay Seymour Flux six times, and an answer to 'I already beat it'.
proposals.cost: 4-6 days; most switches already exist as engine capability.
proposals.fidelityRisk: Low-to-medium, entirely UI discipline - modifiers must be visibly outside Faithful and a plain clear never confused with a modified one.
